text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I gave it my all, but I couldn't become 
the queen... Even so, I won't give up on 
my path to becoming a princess...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, I overheard them. The spectators 
saying... "She lost because she wasn't 
worthy of being queen."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To think that my rough behavior was 
hurting so many people without me even 
realizing...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The thing Trainer had been hiding before 
wasn't a present, either.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So you kept those letters of criticism 
away so that they wouldn't meet my eyes... 
...Am I an unwanted princess?
